tokens.name: canvas
tokens.usage: Plot ground and page background. Warm paper in light, midnight blue in dark. Text on it: ink, ink-body, ink-muted.

tokens.name: panel
tokens.usage: Sidebar background. Text on it: ink, ink-body, ink-muted.

tokens.name: card
tokens.usage: Wells inside the sidebar (formula rows, inputs) and the surface of icon buttons. Text on it: ink, ink-body, ink-muted.

tokens.name: dock-glass
tokens.usage: Translucent fill of the floating control dock and the panel-expand button; always with a backdrop blur over canvas.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Titles, formula text and live readout values on canvas, panel and card.

tokens.name: ink-body
tokens.usage: Running text and row values on canvas, panel and card.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Labels, captions, overlines and units on canvas, panel and card. Never smaller than 11px.

tokens.name: rule
tokens.usage: Decorative hairlines between sidebar sections and around wells. Carries no meaning on its own.

tokens.name: edge
tokens.usage: Borders that carry meaning (icon buttons, toggle off-track, slider rail): 3:1 on canvas, panel and card in both themes.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Interactive state: play button, slider fill and thumb, toggle on-track, selected badge, the s readout. Deliberately the same hue as the curve.

tokens.name: accent-hover
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed state of accent fills and accent text.

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted background for the class badge and hovered ghost controls. Text on it: accent.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Glyphs and text placed on an accent fill (play icon, on-state knob).

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring, 2px solid with 2px offset; at least 3:1 on canvas, panel and card in both themes.

tokens.name: curve
tokens.usage: The reconstructed curve r(s) and its trail. Light: white text on it passes 4.5:1.

tokens.name: tangent
tokens.usage: Tangent vector T and tangent line L_T. Green family.

tokens.name: normal
tokens.usage: Principal normal N and normal line L_N. Vermilion family.

tokens.name: binormal
tokens.usage: Binormal B and the Darboux vector. Reddish purple family.

tokens.name: point
tokens.usage: Active point r(s) and the osculating circle. Amber family.

tokens.name: evolute
tokens.usage: Evolute E(s), the locus of centres of curvature. Always dashed so it is told apart from T by form, not hue alone.

tokens.name: involute
tokens.usage: Involute I(s) (string evolvent). Always dotted.

tokens.name: on-data
tokens.usage: Letters on a solid data-hue fill (the T, N, B tags and the legend dots): 4.5:1 on curve, tangent, normal, binormal, evolute, involute in both themes.

tokens.name: plane-osculating
tokens.usage: Fill of the osculating plane (T, N). Tinted with the hue of B, the vector the plane is perpendicular to.

tokens.name: plane-normal
tokens.usage: Fill of the normal plane (N, B). Tinted with the hue of T.

tokens.name: plane-rectifying
tokens.usage: Fill of the rectifying plane (T, B). Tinted with the hue of N.

tokens.name: plot-grid
tokens.usage: Plotly grid lines and the dot grid behind 2D scenes. Decorative.

tokens.name: plot-axis
tokens.usage: Plotly zero lines and axis spines. Decorative.

styles.name: display-md
styles.usage: Page-level titles in a standalone document.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: The sidebar title next to the mark.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Running text and descriptions in the sidebar.

styles.name: overline
styles.usage: Section titles, set in capitals, numbered with a section sign.

styles.name: readout-lg
styles.usage: The s readout in the dock.

styles.name: readout
styles.usage: Live values in the sidebar (position, kappa, tau, rho, vector components). Tabular figures.

styles.name: tag
styles.usage: Frame tags T, N, B and badges.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap between a glyph and its label.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap inside a row and between small controls.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Padding of wells and of the dock.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Gap between rows in a section.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Sidebar horizontal padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Space above a section title and between sections.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Distance of the dock from the canvas bottom is 24px; this is the gap between major groups in a document.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Large separation in standalone pages.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Tags and badges.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Formula wells, icon buttons.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Panels and popovers.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Large cards in standalone pages.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Dock, speed button, toggle track, slider rail.

tokens.name: shadow-sidebar
tokens.usage: Left edge of the sidebar over the canvas. Borders do the work; this only separates layers.

tokens.name: shadow-dock
tokens.usage: Floating control dock and the panel-expand button.

tokens.name: sidebar-width
tokens.usage: Open width of the sidebar.

tokens.name: control-sm
tokens.usage: Icon buttons in the sidebar header.

tokens.name: control-md
tokens.usage: Dock transport buttons.

tokens.name: control-lg
tokens.usage: Play button.

tokens.name: dock-height
tokens.usage: Floating dock outer height.

tokens.name: z-sidebar
tokens.usage: Sidebar.

tokens.name: z-dock
tokens.usage: Control dock over the canvas.

tokens.name: z-expand
tokens.usage: Panel-expand button shown when the sidebar is collapsed.
